theorem run_append (xs ys : List Instr) (s : List Nat) :
    run (xs ++ ys) s = (run xs s).bind (fun t => run ys t) := by
  induction xs generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i xs ih =>
    cases i with
    | push n => simp [run, ih]
    | plus =>
      cases s with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons a s =>
        cases s with
        | nil => rfl
        | cons b s => simp [run, ih]

theorem compiler_correct_aux (e : Expr) (s : List Nat) :
    run (compile e) s = some (eval e :: s) := by
  induction e generalizing s with
  | lit n => rfl
  | add l r ihl ihr =>
    simp only [compile, eval]
    rw [run_append]
    rw [ihl]
    rw [run_append]
    rw [ihr]
    rfl

theorem compiler_correct (e : Expr) : run (compile e) [] = some [eval e] := by
